advisories.title: Remove the opaque transaction-to-database cast
advisories.body: The double assertion makes the transaction look exactly like the root Drizzle client, including the relational query API, so TypeScript cannot detect a future mismatch in the transaction surface. Use the typed transaction query builder (or a small typed repository function accepting the transaction) for the version lookup and insert instead.
evidence: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:20 casts tx through unknown to typeof db → Improvement: preserves compile-time checking of the transaction API used for the serialized version allocation → Fix: express the lookup and insert against the transaction's native typed query builder or a transaction-parameterized repository helper.
lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:19-39 → the cast is the sole type bridge for both the version query and insert inside the locked transaction.

advisories.title: Publish a web-sized seal asset
advisories.body: This public SVG embeds a 2048px base64 PNG and is 1,880,568 bytes. Every public page that renders the seal downloads that payload as an SVG asset; create a web-sized optimized rendition before publishing it under public/.
evidence: Premise: public/seal-arca.svg:1-17 embeds its raster artwork as a data URI → Improvement: reduces public-page transfer and decode cost while keeping the same seal treatment → Fix: export and commit an optimized web-resolution seal instead of the 2048px master with embedded PNG.
wc -c public/seal-arca.svg docs/design/opendesign/assets/seal-arca-master.svg → the served asset is an unchanged 1,880,568-byte design master.
